items.source: Exposes a "jndiName" property. This may or may not include the "java:comp/env/" prefix expected by Jakarta EE applications when accessing a locally mapped (Environmental Naming Context) resource. If it doesn't, the "java:comp/env/" prefix will be prepended if the "resourceRef" property is true (the default is false) and no other scheme (for example, "java:") is given.
items.translation: 暴露一个 `"jndiName"` 属性。该属性可能包含也可能不包含 Jakarta EE 应用程序在访问本地映射（环境命名上下文）资源时预期的 "java:comp/env/" 前缀。如果未包含，且 "resourceRef" 属性为 true（默认值为 false），并且未提供其他方案（例如 "java:"），则会添加 "java:comp/env/" 前缀。

items.source: Subclasses may invoke the lookup() method whenever it is appropriate. Some classes might do this on initialization, while others might do it on demand. The latter strategy is more flexible in that it allows for initialization of the locator before the JNDI object is available.
items.translation: 子类可以在适当的时候调用lookup() 方法。某些类可能在初始化时执行此操作，而其他类则可能按需执行。后一种策略更为灵活，因为它允许在 JNDI 对象可用之前初始化定位器。

items.source: Invoked by the containing BeanFactory after it has set all bean properties and satisfied BeanFactoryAware, ApplicationContextAware etc.
items.translation: 由包含的 `BeanFactory` 在设置所有 bean 属性并满足 `BeanFactoryAware`、`ApplicationContextAware` 等接口后调用。

Return the type that the located JNDI object is supposed
to be assignable to, if any.
items.translation: 返回定位到的 JNDI 对象应该可赋值给的类型（如果有）。

items.source: Return the JNDI name to look up.
items.translation: 返回用于查找的 JNDI 名称。

items.source: Perform the actual JNDI lookup for this locator's target resource.
items.translation: 为此定位器的目标资源执行实际的 JNDI 查找。

items.source:
Specify the type that the located JNDI object is supposed
to be assignable to, if any.
items.translation: 指定定位到的 JNDI 对象应可赋值给的类型（如有）。

items.source:
Specify the JNDI name to look up. If it doesn't begin with "java:comp/env/"
this prefix is added automatically if "resourceRef" is set to "true".
items.translation: 指定要查找的 JNDI 名称。如果它不以 "java:comp/env/" 开头，且 "resourceRef" 设置为 "true"，则会自动添加此前缀。

items.source: NamingException - if the JNDI lookup failed or if the located JNDI object is not assignable to the expected type
items.translation: NamingException - 如果 JNDI 查找失败，或者找到的 JNDI 对象不可分配给预期类型

items.source:
This method allows the bean instance to perform validation of its overall
configuration and final initialization when all bean properties have been set.
items.translation: 此方法允许 Bean 实例在其所有属性设置完成后，执行其整体配置验证和最终初始化。

items.source: Specify the JNDI name to look up.
items.translation: 指定要查找的 JNDI 名称。
`afterPropertiesSet` 在接口 `InitializingBean` 中
